summary: Tests, verification harness, and E2E examples for Information Audit (Epic #218 / Feature #227)

entries.migration_impact: Expanded test coverage for audit engine, catalog (including extension goals from #226), and guidance (#225). Helps prevent regressions in core audit, defaults, extensibility, and Question generation. Verification harness elements via unit tests exercising the flows.
entries.agent_notes: Tests cover catalog load (platform+ext), audit producing proposals from catalog (incl ext goals), guidance section presence. Run as part of CI for audit-related changes. Use to verify high-quality non-noisy Questions.
